headline: Treelithon - A countryside retreat  / Not a Number Architects
context: Treelithon reimagines the archetype of the rural stone house of Chalkidiki, set within a long, slender plot where the land descends in a quiet, gentle slope beneath a canopy of mature pines and ancient olive trees.
